claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Butoconazole is an imidazole antifungal that inhibits fungal sterol 14-alpha-demethylase; at 2.5 uM against human cancer cell lines it is expected to be largely inactive because its target (fungal CYP51/ergosterol pathway) is not essential in human cells, and no human off-target cytotoxicity is documented at this concentration.
